cases.name: private-ordinary-members-one-process
cases.note: One process (appbench --keep-process), Pixel Wi-Fi, v17: a private video (yZIXLfi8CZQ: 'Inicia sesion' twice, the rest say private) walks the lane and trips nothing; an ordinary video right after is asked for (no circuit); members only in the Pixel's Spanish (w664JpkrDio) is settled at the fourth request, then autoplay opens the next video.
cases.priorState: The process restored one bot-wall record saved before this run, which the replay starts without. Its only candidate is the LTE attachment's route record from v16-lte-recovery (TV_TIZEN's media 403 benched the account route for _WB5hh7WOb4 at 09:56:41, 30 min TTL; the LTE wall of 09:59:47 is the record the restore dropped as expired; the forced-client runs in between do not touch the book). The book is keyed by network attachment and this run is on Wi-Fi, and that bench only concerns TV_TIZEN for a video this case never opens.
